description: Hatchable lets you host full-stack web applications you build, deploy, and manage via MCP tools..  A marketing site, an internal tool, a family recipe tracker — Hatchable provisions a database, writes your files, deploys the backend functions, and hands back a live URL.  Just prompt "build ... on hatchable".   Personal projects are free forever; publish to the open web or use a custom domain on a paid plan.
